access.edition_or_version: Standard scholarly edition; Brooks (2000) reads the work as confessional literature

mechanics.tone_relevance: Redirects confessional address from God to the reading public, raising the stakes of exposure and making the reader the tribunal.
mechanics.point_of_view: First person, retrospective, with direct address to the reader as judge and witness.
mechanics.emotional_progression: Disclosure escalates from youthful incidents to admissions of shame, humiliation, and desire.
mechanics.style_and_devices: Direct reader address; self-justifying and self-accusing rhetoric held in tension; candid admission joined to defensive framing.
mechanics.intimacy_technique: Exposure framed as a claim to singular truthfulness, which invites the reader to evaluate sincerity.
mechanics.why_it_matters: Demonstrates both the power of addressed disclosure and its central failure mode: the reader cannot verify the confession and may read it as performance.
mechanics.copyright_note: Original French public domain. Techniques described, no text reproduced.
